answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 63 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The atlas schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the lagoon checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 107 effective identities must lock that capital for 63 epochs and keep it locked through every oasis audit. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
